unclassified_arrivals.name: Angela Downes
unclassified_arrivals.note: Not on the 2009-10 roster (her class then was only Ahmadian and Manwaring at PGY-2). 2010-11 not observable, so she joined in 2010-11 or 2011-12. Graduated 2015. Phase 2: she co-authored with USF neurosurgery faculty from 2009 (PMIDs 19795957, 21438020), so she was probably at USF (research) before joining the residency; no other program's roster lists her.

unclassified_arrivals.name: Michael S. Park
unclassified_arrivals.note: Not on the 2009-10 roster. Arrived 2010-11 or 2011-12 into Sack's class, probably filling Sack's spot. Shown as PGY-6 in both 2014-15 and 2015-16 (repeated or extra year); graduated 2017. Phase 2: no pre-2012 neurosurgery affiliation found in PubMed; the crossmatch pair with Utah's Paul Park is a different person (first name differs).

problems: No roster gaps. For other programs (not written here): (1) program 41 (Northwestern) has no transfer-out row for Glenn Pollock (left after 2006-07 or 2007-08 -> USF). (2) program 101 rows 2544/2545 infer UPR entry 2015 for both Flores-Milan and Carballo Cuello; USF placed them at PGY-5 in 2020-21 and 2021-22 (entry-equivalent 2016 and 2017), so either the 101 entry years are off or each repeated/lost a year on transfer. (3) The adjudicator uses a transfer-in row's start_year as the entry cohort, so joiners (and Pollock, entry 2005) are listed under their USF arrival year. Park PGY-6 twice (2014-16) and Petoe PGY-5 -> PGY-7 (2022-24) are real roster irregularities, not parse errors.
